scope: Reproduce and assign the AC1009 save failure found by the clean LibreCAD_3 origin/master focused round-trip selector.

validation.build: PASS: clean-source cmake configure and `cmake --build /private/tmp/p8-lc3-origin-clean-build --target lcunittest -j4`.
validation.result: 5/6 pass. DxfExportTest (3/3), DxfRoundTripTest.BinaryAndAsciiCarryTheSameText, and FormatTest.LibdxfrwApiIsUnchanged pass. DxfRoundTripTest.AsciiRoundTripStaysAscii fails on its first AC1009 save; the failure log is DRW::error 2, emit-failure during HEADER emission.
validation.reproduction: The test source writes an ASCII AC1009 file, opens it, confirms the recorded target is not binary, then asks LibreCAD_3 to save it as ASCII AC1009. Save is refused before the test reaches the AC1014/AC1015/AC1027 loop cases.

cause.consumerAdapter: LibreCAD_3 persistence/libdxfrw/dxfimpl.cpp::DXFimpl::writeHeader unconditionally adds $INSUNITS=4 for a new drawing and restores a preserved INSUNITS value without filtering by target revision.
cause.writerContract: DRW_Header::canWriteDxfInsunits rejects a present $INSUNITS value for targets through AC1014. DRW_Header::write applies this guard before emitting HEADER fields. Existing hardening tests assert atomic refusal for AC1014 rather than silently dropping the value.
cause.result: The AC1009 failure is an adapter target-field mismatch, not a regression in libdxfrw ASCII encoding or the DXF writer.

recommendedConsumerChange: At the LibreCAD_3 adapter boundary, omit $INSUNITS when the selected target is AC1009 or AC1014 and report the resulting unit-metadata loss through the save result. Retain libdxfrw's fail-closed preflight for callers that explicitly supply an unrepresentable value.
limitations: This receipt identifies a LibreCAD_3 change; no consumer source was modified in the libdxfrw workspace.
The focused run aborts the ASCII loop on AC1009, so AC1014 ASCII save behavior is not established by that test run.
No DXF/DWG fixture was added and no support claim is promoted.

planImpact.completedSlice: Clean LibreCAD_3 origin/master build passes; focused export tests, binary/ascii text parity, and the API fingerprint pass.
planImpact.remainingP8D: Apply and qualify target-aware INSUNITS omission/loss reporting in LibreCAD_3 for pre-AC1015 saves, then rerun ASCII AC1009/AC1014 plus the existing DXF selectors; continue clean consumer, ABI, DWG and platform gates.
